A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the diversity of N2 fixing bacteria is much greater than we had thought.
we have isolated and identified a number of N2‐ fixers from rice fields along Yangtze River plain and identified their nif genes.
the nif genes in these strains are diverse in size, number and location, and that these strains may have a wide range of nif gene organization and expression.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we identified nif genes from 14 strains of N2 fixing bacteria isolated from rice field in the Yangtse River Plain.
there is a lot of genetic diversity among the bacteria we isolated from rice fields and that some of them have the genes needed to make nitrogen gas (N2).
the nifH gene is a very good molecular tool for studying the diversity of nitrogen‐fixing bacteria.
